task_description: Build a complete full-stack Rental Agreement Analyzer web app from scratch. Users upload a PDF; the Node.js/Express backend extracts text page-by-page via pdfjs-dist, sends it to an OpenAI-compatible LLM, validates the structured JSON response with Zod, stores it in SQLite via better-sqlite3, and optionally generates a PDF report via pdfkit. The React/Vite frontend shows drag-and-drop upload, 6-stage loading animation, summary cards, 15-field details table, clause checklist, conditions list, risk summary, download buttons, and analysis history.
